analysis_contract.D_definition: D(T,mu)=[eta_star(mu,T)/eta_star(0,T)]/(1-mu), per arm, per S, mu=0.9, using the same arm's mu0 fit at the same S

eta_star_estimator.curve: loss=a*x^2+b*x+c fitted to the four seed-mean grid losses at the exact registered eta values (supports the registered 2x-spaced ARM T S10240 mu0.9 ladder)
eta_star_estimator.divergence_rule: any required nonfinite/missing seed cell makes the curve invalid rather than excludable
eta_star_estimator.interior_rule: a>0 and vertex -b/(2a) strictly inside the numeric grid
eta_star_estimator.unbracketed_rule: nonpositive curvature or boundary/outside vertex is UNBRACKETED

seed_ci.interval_scale: log2 eta or log2 D as appropriate
seed_ci.method: paired nonparametric seed bootstrap, refitting eta_star each replicate

analysis_contract.snoo_estimand: equal tuning budget: min over the four registered etas of the five-seed mean loss; paired seed bootstrap on tuned-loss differences
analysis_contract.successive_pair_gap: paired bootstrap of log2 D(T_i) - log2 D(T_j) with one shared seed draw applied to all four underlying curves per replicate

not_evaluable_preconditions: all 10 ARM T eta optima interior

G3a.on_FAIL: stop the finite-horizon claim; audit paper fallback
requirements_for_PASS: for each successive pair (T=2,5),(5,10),(10,20),(20,40): the paired 95% CI for log2 D(T_small) - log2 D(T_large) has lower endpoint > 0 (strict monotone decrease)
the paired five-seed 95% CI for D_obs(T=5) contains the pilot value 2.441338 (replication)

G3b.inputs: ARM B fits only (own mu0 denominators), five fresh seeds
not_evaluable_preconditions: all 10 ARM B eta optima interior
all ARM B work evidence valid
G3b.on_FAIL: the bias-correction invariance claim is refuted; audit paper fallback
G3b.registered_prediction: |log2 D_corrected| <= 0.15 at every T while the raw arm's D spans >= 4x (span reported descriptively)
requirements_for_PASS: |log2 D_corrected(T)| <= 0.15 at >= 4 of 5 T values (point estimates from the frozen analyzer)

G3c.estimand: tuned(b)-tuned(a) and tuned(b)-tuned(c) with paired seed bootstrap CIs; margin 0.01 loss reported
G3c.role: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: reported with the registered snoo_verdict vocabulary; never stops the program and never gates any claim

verdict_rules.NOT_EVALUABLE: missing/invalid ARM S work or any invalid bootstrap replicate

intervention_code.commit_index_rule: t = ceil(base_version/F)+1 from the round-robin version ledger; checkpoint-consistent across resume
intervention_code.off_path_bit_identity: flag off is bit-identical to the production path (Rust regression test bias_correction_off_path_is_bit_identical_to_production_nesterov); mu=0 with the flag ON is also bit-identical (test bias_correction_with_zero_momentum_is_bit_identical_to_off)
intervention_code.semantics: at the fragment's t-th outer commit (1-indexed) the applied Nesterov outer step is divided by (1 - mu^(t+1)), making every commit's constant-gradient multiplier exactly the steady-state 1/(1-mu); derived from the code-true Lean algebra (FiniteHorizonOuter.codeTrue_terminalMultiplier_closed_form)

objective: Confirmatory test of the finite-horizon outer-momentum law D(T,mu)=eta*(mu)/eta*(0)/(1-mu): (ARM T) raw code-true Nesterov tuned-LR deviation is a decreasing function of the per-fragment outer-commit horizon T; (ARM B) an Adam-style outer bias correction dividing the applied step at commit t by (1-mu^(t+1)) makes the tuned optimum horizon-INVARIANT at eta*(0)*(1-mu); (ARM S) SNOO-style M=1 outer momentum gains are or are not explained by the same effective-LR law.

lane_d_lean_mechanism.key_theorem: codeTrue_terminalMultiplier_closed_form: the code-true Nesterov constant-gradient multiplier at buffer age T is (1-mu^(T+1))/(1-mu)
